summary:
SPHEREX is a NASA space mission designed to conduct the first all-sky spectral survey in the near-infrared. 
It aims to create the most comprehensive and colorful three-dimensional map of the universe to date.Rather than simply taking photographs, SPHEREX performs spectroscopy, breaking down infrared light into 102 distinct color channels. The color of the light waves arriving from space reveals which elements emitted them and which gas clouds they have passed through.
By separating the light from objects into 102 different colors, the instrument can precisely determine their chemical composition and distance; specific filters allow only certain wavelengths to pass through.
Computers then process these different wavelengths, distinguishing the colors and combining them to form an image
details:
SPHEREX is a NASA space mission designed to conduct the first all-sky spectral survey in the near-infrared.

It aims to create the most comprehensive and colorful three-dimensional map of the universe to date.Rather than simply taking photographs, SPHEREX performs spectroscopy, breaking down infrared light into 102 distinct color channels. The color of the light waves arriving from space reveals which elements emitted them and which gas clouds they have passed through.

By separating the light from objects into 102 different colors, the instrument can precisely determine their chemical composition and distance; specific filters allow only certain wavelengths to pass through.

Computers then process these different wavelengths, distinguishing the colors and combining them to form an imageNASA has developed two significant telescopes: the James Webb and the SPHEREx.

Although these two telescopes possess very different functions, they both carry out equally important work.
